args.message: I added up revenue and credit limits separately for each region, so joining orders to customers doesn't count any credit limit twice. Credit is summed over all 202 customers, including those who never ordered. Revenue covers all 5,016 orders. The unlabelled (null) region is the "no known region" group. It holds 16 orders totalling 1,193.30 whose customer either doesn't exist in the customer table or has no region. It also holds the one customer with no region, whose credit limit is 500. Arctic has no customers or orders, so both of its values are null.
